info.name: Birinchi Shop Partner API v1
info.description:
Birinchi Shop Partner API v1 — COD CPA affiliate network in Uzbekistan.

1. Import `birinchishop-api-v1.postman_environment.json`, select it and paste your key into `bsk_key` (Dashboard → API in the partner panel). Keep the key secret: do not share a collection export with the value filled in.
2. Set the id variables (`offer_id`, `link_id`, …) to your own objects.

**`POST /orders` creates a REAL order** (a call center phones the customer). Never send test or fake orders.

Docs: https://birinchishop.uz/api/v1/docs · OpenAPI: https://birinchishop.uz/api/v1/openapi.json · Examples: https://github.com/Birinchishop/birinchishop-api-examples

Generated from openapi.json (api_version 2026-10-23). Example responses use fictional data.

request.description:

Estimate 0-100% from the offer sale rate, the order stage, the customer's previous orders across the network, duplicates and rejected leads. The latest value is also in Order.sale_chance_percent.

request.description:
Scope: `orders:write`

**⚠ Creates a REAL order.** A call center phones the customer and a courier delivers the product. Only for a real customer who asked to order, with their correct phone number. Never send test, sample or fake orders — the account gets blocked.

`customer_phone` is empty in the environment on purpose, so an accidental Send fails with `invalid_request`. `Idempotency-Key` uses `{{$guid}}`; when you retry the same order, send the same key so no duplicate is created.

Creates a REAL order; a call center will phone the customer. Never send test or fake orders. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header so that retries never create duplicates (a replay returns 200 with header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

Scope: `webhooks:manage`

kind=json: we POST a signed JSON event. kind=postback: we GET your URL after replacing macros like {click_id}, {status}, {conversion_status}, {payout}. Only public http(s) URLs on ports 80/443/8080/8443. The signing secret is returned ONCE in this response.
